from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, datetime
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_DB_PATH = Path.home() / ".todo-cli" / "todos.db"


class Priority(Enum):
    HIGH = "high"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    LOW = "low"


@dataclass
class Todo:
    id: int
    title: str
    priority: Priority
    due_date: date | None
    done: bool
    created_at: datetime


def get_connection(db_path: Path = DEFAULT_DB_PATH) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_path))
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    _init_schema(conn)
    return conn


def _init_schema(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS todos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
            due_date TEXT,
            done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def _row_to_todo(row: tuple) -> Todo:
    return Todo(
        id=row[0],
        title=row[1],
        priority=Priority(row[2]),
        due_date=date.fromisoformat(row[3]) if row[3] else None,
        done=bool(row[4]),
        created_at=datetime.fromisoformat(row[5]),
    )


def add_todo(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    title: str,
    priority: Priority = Priority.MEDIUM,
    due_date: date | None = None,
) -> Todo:
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO todos (title, priority, due_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (title, priority.value, due_date.isoformat() if due_date else None),
    )
    conn.commit()
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (cursor.lastrowid,)).fetchone()
    return _row_to_todo(row)


def list_todos(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    *,
    show_done: bool = False,
) -> list[Todo]:
    if show_done:
        rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos ORDER BY done, due_date IS NULL, due_date, id").fetchall()
    else:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM todos WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY due_date IS NULL, due_date, id"
        ).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_todo(row) for row in rows]


def mark_done(conn: sqlite3.Connection, todo_id: int) -> Todo | None:
    conn.execute("UPDATE todos SET done = 1 WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,))
    conn.commit()
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return _row_to_todo(row)


def delete_todo(conn: sqlite3.Connection, todo_id: int) -> bool:
    cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,))
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.rowcount > 0

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from datetime import date

import pytest

from todo_cli.db import Priority, add_todo, delete_todo, get_connection, list_todos, mark_done


@pytest.fixture
def conn(tmp_path):
    db_path = tmp_path / "test.db"
    connection = get_connection(db_path)
    yield connection
    connection.close()


class TestAddTodo:
    def test_add_basic(self, conn):
        todo = add_todo(conn, "Buy groceries")
        assert todo.id == 1
        assert todo.title == "Buy groceries"
        assert todo.priority == Priority.MEDIUM
        assert todo.due_date is None
        assert todo.done is False

    def test_add_with_priority(self, conn):
        todo = add_todo(conn, "Fix critical bug", Priority.HIGH)
        assert todo.priority == Priority.HIGH

    def test_add_with_due_date(self, conn):
        due = date(2026, 12, 31)
        todo = add_todo(conn, "Year-end review", due_date=due)
        assert todo.due_date == due

    def test_add_multiple(self, conn):
        t1 = add_todo(conn, "First")
        t2 = add_todo(conn, "Second")
        assert t2.id == t1.id + 1


class TestListTodos:
    def test_list_empty(self, conn):
        todos = list_todos(conn)
        assert todos == []

    def test_list_excludes_done(self, conn):
        add_todo(conn, "Pending task")
        done_todo = add_todo(conn, "Done task")

from __future__ import annotations

from click.testing import CliRunner

import pytest

from todo_cli.cli import cli


@pytest.fixture
def runner(tmp_path):
    db_path = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    r = CliRunner()

    def invoke(*args):
        return r.invoke(cli, ["--db", db_path, *args])

    return invoke


class TestAddCommand:
    def test_add_basic(self, runner):
        result = runner("add", "Buy milk")
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "Buy milk" in result.output

    def test_add_with_priority(self, runner):
        result = runner("add", "Urgent task", "-p", "high")
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "Urgent task" in result.output

    def test_add_with_due_date(self, runner):
        result = runner("add", "Review docs", "-d", "2026-12-31")
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "Review docs" in result.output

    def test_add_invalid_priority(self, runner):
        result = runner("add", "Bad task", "-p", "critical")
        assert result.exit_code != 0


class TestListCommand:
    def test_list_empty(self, runner):
        result = runner("list")
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "No todos found" in result.output

    def test_list_shows_added(self, runner):
        runner("add", "Task one")
        runner("add", "Task two")
        result = runner("list")
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "Task one" in result.output
        assert "Task two" in result.output

    def test_list_hides_done(self, runner):
        runner("add", "Active task")
        runner("add", "Completed task")
        runner("done", "2")
        result = runner("list")
        assert "Active task" in result.output
        assert "Completed task" not in result.output

    def test_list_all_shows_done(self, runner):
        runner("add", "Active task")
        runner("add", "Completed task")
        runner("done", "2")
        result = runner("list", "--all")
        assert "Active task" in result.output
        assert "Completed task" in result.output


class TestDoneCommand:
    def test_done(self, runner):
        runner("add", "Finish report")
        result = runner("done", "1")
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "Completed" in result.output

    def test_done_nonexistent(self, runner):
        result = runner("done", "999")
        assert result.exit_code != 0
        assert "not found" in result.output


class TestDeleteCommand:
    def test_delete(self, runner):
        runner("add", "Temporary task")
        result = runner("delete", "1")
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "Deleted" in result.output

    def test_delete_nonexistent(self, runner):
        result = runner("delete", "999")
        assert result.exit_code != 0
        assert "not found" in result.output
